title: [Main] - User encounters a "record is not open" error when attaching a document to a posted sales shipment in Dynamics 365 (Base Application v28)
summary: Document attachment uploads now work correctly for posted sales shipments and return receipts by adding missing table references and hardening error handling.
key_points: Added missing Database::Sales Shipment Header and Database::Return Receipt Header cases to GetRefTable
Opens RecordRef correctly before passing to SaveAttachment
Added error handling with OnAfterGetRecRefFail event to surface clear messages
Prevents cryptic 'record is not open' errors when uploading documents
Applied consistent pattern used for other posted sales documents
quote: Added the missing Database::Sales Shipment Header and Database::Return Receipt Header cases to GetRefTable, each opening the RecordRef on its table.
